title: Nuclear Isomers
description: Some nuclei can sit in an excited state for years, held there by their spin. Hafnium-178m2 holds 2.4 MeV per nucleus for thirty-one years. Unlocks the Isomer Trigger.

puzzle.goal: Each nucleus of an isomer stores an energy E; a mole of them weighs M and holds N of them. Write the energy U each kilogram stores.
puzzle.name: Spin-trap capacity
puzzle.ask: Find U in GJ/kg (u = @{u}) for hafnium-178m2: E = @{E} J (2.446 MeV), N = @{N} /mol, M = @{M} kg/mol.
puzzle.method: Nuclei per kilogram are N/M; each gives E.
